prerequisites.title: DirectX 12 system requirement
prerequisites.summary: KOEI TECMO lists DirectX 12 or over in the Steam system requirements. This scan does not check installed DirectX components, graphics feature support, or overall system compatibility.
prerequisites.evidence: Official Steam specification: DirectX 12 or over.
prerequisites.recommendation: Compare the full system with the game's official requirements and use Windows or graphics-vendor tools to check DirectX feature support. Install prerequisites only through their publisher or operating-system vendor.

compatibility.title: Official frame-rate fix for a DLC companion issue
compatibility.summary: KOEI TECMO lists a Steam v1.0.1.1 update dated 2026-01-30 that fixed battle frame-rate drops after selecting a companion added in the Visions of Four Heroes DLC. The installed game version and symptom were not assessed, so this does not establish that this installation is affected.
compatibility.evidence: Official update note: Steam v1.0.1.1 fixed the described issue.
compatibility.recommendation: If this matches the symptom, check the installed version in Steam and allow the official client to install available updates. Recheck the game behavior yourself.
